---
title: "sFig2 "
output: html_notebook
---

Download libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

Download RData from the folder.
```{r}
# Load RData file containing data required for analysis and visualization.
load("multiple_cohorts_data.RData")

source("FunctionCollection.R")

# Define a list of datasets (unique study ID)
datasets <- c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK")

# The clinical and gene expression data is stored as df_tf.
df_tf <- df_tf %>%
  distinct(SampleID, StudyID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_C1_pre <- df_tf %>% 
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") %>%
  dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_C2_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[2] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

df_NSCLC_pre <- df_tf %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[3] & BiopsyTime == "Pre") # %>%
  # dedup_one_biopsy_per_patient(., prefer = "Pre")

# Combine all pre-tx samples from three cohorts
df_pre <- rbind(df_C1_pre, df_C2_pre, df_NSCLC_pre)

```


Cohort 1 Pre-Tx 50% IRF2/50% IRF1 - Plot survival curves.
```{r}
df_C1 <- df_pre %>%
  subset(StudyID == datasets[1] & BiopsyTime == "Pre")

FigS2_C1_IRF2_P50 <- plot_km_nested_subset(df = df_C1,
                                           geneA = "IRF2",
                                           geneB = "IRF1", 
                                           splitA = 50,
                                           splitB = 50,
                                           subsetA = "High", 
                                           max_years = 5, 
                                           show_metrics = "none", 
                                           landmark_years = 1)

FigS2_C1_IRF2_P50
```

Cohort 1 & 2 & NSCLC Pre-Tx - Plot IRF2 expression level as bar graph.
```{r}
FigS2_IRF1 <- plot_gene_expr_barplot(df = df_pre,
                       genes = "IRF1",
                       norm_type = "log2", 
                       group_col = "StudyID", 
                       selected_cohorts = c("PHS000452_GSE91061","PRJEB23709","SU2CMARK"))

FigS2_IRF1
```



```{r}
FigS2 <- ggarrange(FigS2_C1_IRF2_P50$plot,
                   FigS2_C1_IRF2_P35$plot,
                   FigS2_C1_IRF2_P15$plot,
                   FigS2_C2_IRF2_P50$plot,
                   FigS2_NSCLC_IRF2_P50$plot,
                   FigS2_IRF1,
          nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

FigS2
```
